items.stem: A text argues strongly but gives no evidence. How should you evaluate its argument?

options.text: As weak, because confident tone is not the same as support
options.rationale: Correct: a claim needs evidence, not just a confident tone.

options.text: As strong, because it sounds very sure
options.rationale: Tone alone does not make an argument strong.

options.text: As fact, because it is written down
options.rationale: Being written does not make a claim factual.

options.text: As impossible to evaluate at all
options.rationale: You can evaluate it precisely: it lacks support.

items.explanation: Correct: a claim needs evidence, not just a confident tone.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which statement is an opinion rather than a fact?

options.text: Homework is a waste of students' time.
options.rationale: Correct: this is a judgement that can be debated.

options.text: Water boils at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
